source.verse_hash_method: SHA-256 of exact original XML verse substrings including all written/read and other notes, not normalized reconstructions.
source.public_versification_note: Public Judges 6–12 and Hebrew source references align one to one. All 230 original source records are bound exactly once.

key_decisions.decision: Keep the political choice as Abimelech frames it, citizen term and bodily kinship appeal.
Keep sacred funds, implied weight unit and narrator’s moral description.
Preserve stated seventy beside one survivor, without correcting the count.
Retain both groups and uncertain landmark rather than identifying it with another tree.
Preserve rich oil, gods/people and the sway refrain; note God as alternative.
Retain divine and human enjoyment and the fable’s refrain without doctrinal correction.
Preserve implausible shade and consuming fire, allowing the fable’s threat to speak.
Keep the thrown-life image and the son’s favorable claim about his father.
Preserve seventy, single stone, slave-woman designation in Jotham’s accusation and kinship motive.
Retain both directions of the fire curse and all named parties.
Retain God’s agency and evil spirit, noting spirit of hostility as an interpretation.
Unfold the purpose/result clause while preserving bloodguilt and shared complicity.
Keep the difficult paired identity questions, ancestral appeal and repeated service language.
Retain wish, hand and direct challenge without inventing a messenger or present addressee.
Choose secretly for the difficult Tormah form and stirring up for the compressed siege verb, with alternatives noted.
Preserve both distinctive landscape names with their images, explained selectively.
Retain pursuit, flight and fatal casualties extending to the gate.
Preserve the source’s plural companies alongside two others, noting the numerical compression.
Retain the entire destruction sequence and symbolic salting without a modern agronomic explanation.
Keep El-berith distinct from Baal-berith in form and uncertain inner structure.
Make the burning of people explicit and preserve approximate mixed-gender total.
Retain both sex-specific groups, citizens and elevated refuge without flattening the list.
Preserve unnamed woman’s agency, household implement and severe wound.
Retain his concern about death by a woman as his own speech and the attendant’s final blow.
Retain narrator’s divine repayment judgment and unchanged stated count.
Preserve heads image and explicit link to Jotham’s curse.
